HOW TO USE DARTH CHERRY WITH POLYBIUS
---------------------------------
1. Install both APKs. Open DARTH CHERRY → grant "Display over other apps" → ENABLE.
2. Open Polybius → unlock cipher → ENCRYPT or DECRYPT.
3. Under the red veil a hidden eyeball appears:
   - Tap  = fade-type (letters flash then fade)
   - Hold through a 3s red-pupil blink = matrix green veil (plaintext hidden)
   - Tap again / disable filter = normal visible plaintext
Without DARTH CHERRY, Polybius shows plaintext normally.

HOW TO ENTER THE CRYPTO ENGINE
------------------------------
1. Launch PØLYBĪUS.
2. Ritual: hold title 6s → SETTINGS → difficulty 11 → LANGUAGES → Russian
   → hold SELECT 3s.
3. Portal: login · password (or backup) · invite/dev code → PIN.
